reason: Three months free and it sits next to my POS, so trying it costs me nothing but some table stickers. I'd sign up for the trial, but whether I keep paying 59 GEL after that depends on regulars actually using the QR and coming back for the offers.
objection: You're a new startup. Will you still be around in a year, and if you vanish, who keeps my guest list and the reviews? I want to be able to export my guest data and know you won't sell it or use it to push diners to other places in your app.
would_change_my_mind: If the contract doesn't say clearly that the guest data is mine and I can export it whenever I want, I won't put the QR codes on my tables.
